case.summary: Case HHG-002, opened 2016-11-22, concerned online transaction 3478782 for $292.36 on card C11891-K1, which triggered a bank risk score of 0.79. Although the transaction amount exceeded the card's 95th percentile for online purchases, the investigation concluded the transaction was legitimate with a fraud probability of 0.04. This decision was based on a classifier score of 0.01 and the final fraud probability being at or below 0.15 on two independent signals. Initial and final actions were to allow the transaction and close the case as legitimate, consistent with Policy 6. A prior confirmed card-not-present fraud (CC-4160) on the same card was noted, but did not change the verdict for this specific transaction. No suspicious activity report was recommended.
